summary: WebRender can now render CSS `clip-path: path()` and `shape()` using antialiased path clips, and draws more SVG shapes and borders directly through its renderer. On Linux and Wayland, it also improves handling of shared image buffers; on Windows, it adds a dynamic-texture option for the DirectComposition layer compositor and updates HDR video swap-chain color formats. Together, these changes improve graphics quality and support across platforms.
